name: Standard Meeting Notes
description: A standard template for general meetings, focusing on key outcomes and actions.

sections.title: Summary
sections.instruction: State the main outcome in one or two short factual sentences. For sparse notes, one sentence is enough. Do not repeat every task or add context the source does not give.

sections.title: Key Decisions
sections.instruction: List only explicit decisions or agreements. Keep proposals, rejected ideas, and unresolved matters out of this section.

sections.title: Action Items
sections.instruction: Use one concise checklist item per explicit task. Include the owner and due date only if stated. Append a supplied transcript timestamp only when it supports that task. For typed notes, omit timestamps. Do not use a table or create placeholder tasks when none were assigned.
sections.item_format: - [ ] Task (owner and due date only if stated)

sections.title: Discussion Highlights
sections.instruction: List relevant context and explicitly unresolved issues not covered above. Preserve limitations and uncertainty, without inventing questions, explanations, or next steps.
